messages:
Maya: Heads-up 1x: HelixCloud QBR prep  renewal ~7w. Need an exec-ready 90s ask, 1-pg risk brief, and a slide for onboarding health. Who can pick these up? :wave:
Ethan: Ill draft the 90s ask + recommended commercial motion. Will bring ARR impact and ask lanes.
Rafa: Ill own onboarding slide. Current onboarding completion 64% (4 blocked integrations). Will call out playbook steps and owners.
Lina: Noted spike in support volume post-integration last month. Renewal risk moved 0.18 -> 0.39. Main friction: prompt tuning and role-based docs.
Maya: @Lina can you paste 2 anonymized support snippets we can quote?
Lina: Snippets (anonymized): "Tokenization differences caused context truncation during production tests" and "Need playbooks for SSO and entitlement mapping."
Owen: Ill pull SLA and usage trends for the 1-pager. Quick SLA blurb: `Last quarter incidents: 2 infra, 2 perf; avg MTTR 3.1h; no severity-1`. Full export -> Drive.
EBR-bot: Reminder: QBR prep dry run Thurs 11:00am PT  calendar invite sent to execs, AMs, and product owner.
Maya: Keep slide count tight (<=4). Include two fallback offers: 1) technical concierge + SRE hours, 2) Dedicated capacity evaluation (include indicative cost delta).
Ethan: Adding revenue numbers to Drive: https://drive.redwood/qbr/helixcloud-ask  estimate at-risk ARR ~$85k; downside $30k.
Rafa: On onboarding fixes: scripted kickoff checklist, partner integrator templates, weekly concierge call. Will show TTF and blocked-integration breakdown.
Lina: For the risk brief propose 3-tier response: immediate triage (concierge), medium (configuration + docs sprint), longer (model tuning engagement). Will draft remediation timelines.
Owen: Uploaded console charts showing latency and token consumption trends. Will link in the 1-pager.
Maya: Owner recap: Ask (Ethan), Onboarding (Rafa), Risk brief (Lina), SLA & usage (Owen). Please confirm by EOD and add any exec-level quotes to your slide. :thumbsup:
Rafa: Confirmed  slide draft by 3pm.
Ethan: Confirmed  will prep 90s script and speaker notes.
Lina: Confirmed  will add anonymized quotes + NPS context.
Owen: Confirmed  will attach drives and the CSV.
Maya: One ask for the dry run  bring two mitigations per top risk and propose the speaker order. Well rehearse handoffs. See you Thursday. :calendar:
